query: find cool new self-hosted note apps
expected_behavior: Runs scout.py once with keywords like "self-hosted notes" in the same tool-call turn as 1-3 WebSearch queries (for example r/selfhosted or awesome-selfhosted)
Answers with a table of 8-12 tools: name, what it is, signal plus date, link
At least 60% of listed items were created, launched or posted in the last 60 days
Items come from at least 3 distinct source types (for example GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, web search)
Prefers new or rising projects over famous ones such as Joplin, Obsidian or Notion
All links are real URLs taken from script output or search results, not invented
Does not fetch each item to verify it
Runs scout.py once with keywords like "mcp server" in the same tool-call turn as 1-3 WebSearch queries (for example mcp.so, glama.ai or r/mcp)
Answers with a table of 8-12 MCP servers: name, what it is, signal plus date, link
At least 60% of listed items are from the last 60 days
Items come from at least 3 distinct source types (for example GitHub, npm, Hacker News, Hugging Face)
Does not lead with the well-known reference servers only
All links are real URLs taken from script output or search results
Does not fetch each item to verify it
Searches for what Loom does (for example "screen recorder") rather than only the word Loom
Runs scout.py once in the same tool-call turn as 1-3 WebSearch queries (for example alternativeto.net or opensourcealternative.to)
Answers with a table of 8-12 open-source screen recording tools: name, what it is, signal plus date, link
At least 60% of listed items are from the last 60 days
Items come from at least 3 distinct source types
All links are real URLs taken from script output or search results
Does not fetch each item to verify it
